title: Age-related changes in cortical 1/f dynamics are linked to cardiac activity
goal: Recreate the Salzburg participant-level age–spectral-slope finding across the original cardiac-component conditions and assess proposed improvements to that same scientific analysis.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable analysis and source-native outputs for the corrected primary empirical findings: The original Salzburg statistical confound analysis represented by Figure 4—figure supplement 4: retain source-eligible participant identities and the ECG-retained, ECG-rejected and isolated cardiac-component conditions; reconstruct the source Bayesian age–slope models and the complete source-defined condition contrast. Bind the released measurements to source model columns and inferential outputs. This does not require raw ICA/spectral preprocessing or the separate full CamCAN analysis.
Primary improvement: unavailable until a source-grounded same-result comparison is independently justified; no new score or direction is implied.

Retained secondary work: Retain the genuine Figure 3A–D empirical result: original 20-person concurrent M/EEG/ECG forward TRFs and backward ECG reconstruction, preserving modality, cardiac-component condition and original temporal cross-validation. Report this separately; it cannot satisfy primary age-confound reproduction or improvement.
success_criteria: Recreate the corrected primary empirical findings with their source-defined populations, complete required panels and controls.
Use an explicitly bound reproduction proposal only within its declared eligibility, comparison and execution limits; copying published findings is insufficient.

The preserved improvement.v1.json retains its declared comparison and coverage. Use retained_secondary_scope for its relationship to the corrected primary findings; satisfying a secondary or partial-component criterion alone does not establish complete primary reproduction or improvement.

The primary same-target outcome bundle is unavailable. Any primary improvement requires an independently justified source-grounded comparison; no replacement metric, direction or tolerance is invented.
Keep the paper+data and paper+data+author-code outcomes separate. All scientific outcomes remain unknown until qualifying original-data execution and independent verification.
Preserve prior task definitions, improvement criteria and useful secondary implementations with their original scopes. Historical attempts and source metadata do not become qualified AI results.

retained_secondary_improvement.baseline_policy: Bind the source-author temporal-response-function implementation and numerical Figure 3 scores. A local Bayesian age model, OLS companion, reconstructed posterior or reimplemented decoder on new folds is not the source predictive baseline.

primary_source_limits: The historical definition leaves the exact age-model formula, condition-column mapping and participant eligibility unbound; restore its named result without pretending those details are already qualified.
The paper reports 655 analyzed Salzburg recordings from 684 collected; the cohort is not age-diverse, with 423 participants younger than 30. Preserve its source population and interpretation.
Original numerical reference outputs, source-code/model parity and defensible reproduction acceptance criteria remain to be bound for the age analysis.

No authenticated ordered superiority criterion for the primary age-confound analysis is established. Larger coefficients, smaller p-values or better ECG decoding do not themselves demonstrate improvement.
Existing Figure 3 source components and reviewed scalar bookkeeping remain useful secondary evidence; their identity, native execution and verifier limitations remain.

No accepted explicit authority replacing the original primary was found in the inspected records. Current improvement rationale and REVIEW-rep014.json demonstrate a retargeting and internally reviewed TRF draft, not continuity with the retained original primary.

retained_secondary_improvement: Exact original Figure 3C,D reconstruction-r values, subject vectors and partition-to-summary aggregation are unrecovered.

The original source uses ECG-informed ICA and acausal lags; an honest evaluation must preserve and disclose that information regime without allowing candidate access to final ECG targets.
